errors.text: The requested critical threshold is not identified: the target places the onset of significant diffusion and segregation at approximately 673 K, whereas the hypothesis leaves T_crit unspecified.
The claimed ordering that icosahedral particles necessarily have a lower T_crit than truncated octahedra is asserted without evidence and may not follow from curvature alone.
The proposed >20 nm boundary and restoration of entropy-stabilized sluggish diffusion are unsupported extrapolations.
